connector.name: Google Analytics MCP
connector.registryDescription: GA4 MCP server for AI agents: schema discovery, server-side aggregation, analysis-ready defaults.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package google-analytics-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the surendranb account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Absolute path to your Google Cloud service account JSON key with GA4 property access.

env.name: GA4_PROPERTY_ID
env.description: Numeric GA4 Property ID to query, for example 123456789.
